pred_ddx.label: Giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath

Giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath: The location and characteristics of the mass, as well as the results of the physical examination maneuvers, could also be indicative of a giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath, although the imaging findings are more typical of a ganglion cyst.
